claims.statement: The effect size reported is the matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation, chosen by the authors because it is the direct companion of the signed-rank test that was run and has a single definition; Rosenthal's z/sqrt(N) is not reported because its N can be read three ways (giving 0.803, 0.819 or 0.568 on the headline).
The signed-rank test keeps the zero_method wilcox (zero differences dropped) because switching to the Pratt method would change an already pre-registered p-value.
The number of non-zero pairs (n_eff) is reported beside every effect size because a bare r = 1.0 invites the false reading that every query improved.
No multiplicity correction is applied because the analysis is a single comparison (A0 versus A1).

The MiniLM embedder is the one used for the routing results reported in the project's documentation, because the authors regard the lexical-hash fallback as a degraded offline mode and not the evaluation baseline.

The effect size originally stored for the headline test (r = 0.688, labelled a rank-biserial correlation) and its z (4.865) were computed incorrectly and are superseded by r = 0.941 and z = 5.679; W, the one-sided p, the percentage reduction, the confidence interval and the per-seed spread did not change.

limitations.statement: The authors state that more seeds cannot narrow a confidence interval that is set by heterogeneity between queries.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The interval over queries, not the per-seed spread, is the honest uncertainty on the size of the saving.

limitations.statement: The authors note that retrieval precision and recall, and route@1 and ownership accuracy, cannot be computed on the single-agent question-answering data because it has no relevant-document labels and no owner labels, and that the fusion system exercises routing with a single expert.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The question-answering comparison does not measure routing quality, which is the axis the authors care about.

limitations.statement: The authors state that ASMOS does not beat RAG on span-retrieval question answering and is not a question-answering-accuracy method.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Nothing in this paper supports an accuracy advantage of ASMOS over retrieval-augmented generation.

limitations.statement: The authors state that ownership asymmetry does not emerge organically because the corpus is deliberately constructed.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The size of the saving is a property of a constructed corpus and must not be read as a rate for organic multi-agent workloads.

limitations.statement: The authors list among their own caveats a convergence and sample-efficiency hypothesis that was tested; its result is not reported here because the result file is not in the package and its reporting is undecided.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: No claim of faster or more sample-efficient learning of ownership is made.

limitations.statement: The authors list three items as explicitly descoped: agent-specific memory projection (the store is global), contradiction detection (refutation is claimed only when supplied as a verification outcome) and continuous forgetting (present but off by default and not wired into a continuous loop).
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The results describe routing with supplied verification outcomes, not a system that detects contradictions or forgets by itself.

limitations.statement: The authors state that the routing threshold tau is tuned in-corpus rather than on a held-out split, that grading in the question-answering ladder is done by an LLM, that the deterministic ownership verification is not LLM-judged, that a memory-reuse threshold is an untuned placeholder that feeds none of the reported numbers, and that their multi-agent validation is one seedless run with an imposed partition; that run's result file is not in the package and no result from it is reported (checkpoint Q-003).
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The saving is measured at a threshold chosen on the same corpus, which can favour ASMOS.

limitations.statement: The authors state that the embedder of their earliest centerpiece run is unconfirmed, and that the LLM-token counts are exact API usage figures that do not depend on the embedder.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The counting is exact, but the quantity counted depends on routing and hence on the embedder; the statement concerns an earlier run that is not reported here and does not establish which embedder the pooled seeds 11 to 55 used.

limitations.statement: The authors exclude one embedder cell (bge-small in the new-topic replication) because the run fell back to the hash embedder and produced a degenerate regret, reporting it as incomplete rather than fabricated.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The embedder comparison in the new-topic regime omits one family and rests on the runs that completed.

limitations.statement: The authors note that a recorded continuous-integration pass or coverage artifact is an outstanding item.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: No software test result is reported here; the numbers rest on the stored result files.

limitations.statement: Seeds 11 to 55 are pooled from a result file that is absent from the package, and per-seed accuracy, answerability, route@1 and context tokens exist only for seeds 66 to 110.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Accuracy and answerability are reported for half of the seeds; the token result can be recomputed from the stored deltas but not from the absent five-seed file.

limitations.statement: The grading procedure for answer accuracy on the transactive corpus is not stated and no paired test of accuracy exists, while A1 is below A0 in every one of five seeds.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The size of the accuracy cost of routing cannot be bounded; the cost saving is not a saving at equal accuracy.

limitations.statement: No significance test, per-seed gap or interval exists for the A1 versus A2 comparison on the 50-query corpus; only pooled arm means are stored.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The attribution to ownership evolution rests on a large, unreplicated-per-seed difference in means and is stated as consistent with, not established.

limitations.statement: The corpus, query set, agent partition and code are not in the package, and the tuning of the classifier baselines (a classifier threshold of 0.5 against 0.351493 for ASMOS) is not documented.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Regret comparisons with the classifier baselines cannot be checked for budget parity.

limitations.statement: The new-topic regime has 5 seeds and 5 evaluation queries per step, answerability is identical for all arms there, and ASMOS regret differs about threefold between the two embedders.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The adaptation result is embedder-dependent and rests on routing precision alone.

limitations.statement: The four-system comparison is one run of 24 questions; exact match equals containment in every row, one system has token-F1 below its exact match, and no p-values are recorded.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The comparison supports direction only, and 'significant' cannot be claimed for any difference.

limitations.statement: The cross-embedder stationary run is a single run with no seeds and no stated query count.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The lexical-hash result is a single observation.

limitations.statement: For the other answering models only signed-rank statistics are recorded, one of them from a one-seed pilot; their percentage reductions are not in the package.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Whether the size of the saving carries over to other answering models is not established.

limitations.statement: Several results listed in the project's README are not reported in this paper because their source result files are not in the package.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The paper is narrower than the project's own summary table and reports only what can be traced to a present file.

limitations.statement: The headline saving is measured with a single answering model (gpt-4o-mini).
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The size of the saving is stated for that model only.

limitations.statement: The token measure is the LLM usage recorded per query; the result file reports no separate cost for computing embeddings, updating ownership or producing verification outcomes.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The saving is a saving in recorded LLM usage per query, not a measured net saving for the whole system.

limitations.statement: No classifier updated online from the same labels is included; ASMOS and the retrained classifiers each consumed 10 labels, and ASMOS used the corpus-tuned threshold 0.351493 while the classifiers used 0.5.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The regret comparison contrasts ASMOS with scheduled retraining, not with a like-for-like online baseline, and is not matched on tuning or update access.

limitations.statement: The per-seed results agree closely (per-seed token reduction std 0.07 percentage points), so the recorded seeds are not independent replications, and the accuracy difference is 1 to 2 of 50 questions per seed.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Even the direction of the accuracy difference rests on few questions under an undocumented grader.

limitations.statement: The cost corpus has two agents, and the new-topic runs do not record how many agents take part.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Nothing is measured for larger teams of agents.

limitations.statement: Route@1 is recorded as a proportion without its denominator, and the criterion for a seed having routed the new topic is not recorded.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Route@1 values and the 5-of-5 counts cannot be traced to query counts.

limitations.statement: The pre-registration the authors cite for keeping zero differences dropped is not documented by a registry entry, date or protocol in the package (their correction record calls the stamped result files the pre-registration record), and the signed-rank tests of the other cost runs are reported without multiplicity correction.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: The one-sided test's pre-specification cannot be checked independently, and the 'single comparison' rationale applies to the headline test only.
